chunks: By this chain of narration, he said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:
Whoever is distraught by his sin and made happy by his good deed is a believer.

key_terms.سيئة: Sin, evil deed — any transgression of divine law
key_terms.مؤمن: Believer — one who has true faith (iman)

ai.seo_question: What is the sign of a true believer according to Prophet Muhammad?
ai.summary: The Prophet (SAWW) provides a concise criterion for identifying true faith: a believer is one whose sins cause him distress and whose good deeds bring him joy. This hadith, transmitted through the same chain as the preceding narration in the assembly, establishes that genuine faith (iman) is reflected in one's emotional response to their own moral conduct.
